explanation: Supporting lemma, not itself on erdosproblems.com/30: |A| ≤ ⌊√(2N)⌋ + 1 for a Sidon set in {0,…,N}. It is correct, since (|A|−1)² ≤ |A|(|A|−1) ≤ 2N. But calling this a 'weak form of Lindström's bound' is loose: its leading constant √2 is worse than the N^{1/2} of Lindström's bound on the page, so it is simply the elementary count. Only the name and docstring are affected.
